title: #LenovoMemory.v1_0_0.LenovoMemory

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

BankLabel.longDescription: A string identifying the physically labeled bank where the Memory is located - for example, 'Bank 0' or 'Bank A'.

Location.description: [URI] the slot info which the memory occupies.

MemoryType.longDescription: This property shall contain the string which identifies the type of memory.

FormFactor.longDescription: The implementation form factor for the Chip. For example, values such as SIMM (7), TSOP (9) or PGA (10) can be specified.

Manufacturer.longDescription: This property shall contain a string which identifies the manufacturer of the memory.

SerialNumber.description: The serial number for this memory
SerialNumber.longDescription: The value of this property shall be a manufacturer-allocated number used to identify the memory.

PartNumber.description: The part number for this memory
PartNumber.longDescription: The value of this property shall be a part number assigned by the organization that is responsible for producing or manufacturing the memory.

Model.description: The product model number of this device
Model.longDescription: This property shall indicate the model information as provided by the manufacturer of this memory.

MaxSpeedMHz.description: The maximum clock speed of the memory
MaxSpeedMHz.longDescription: This property shall indicate the maximum rated clock speed of the memory in MHz.

TotalWidth.longDescription: Total width(in bits), including check or error correction bits. If there are no error correction bits, the value in this property should match that specified for DataWidth.

DataWidth.longDescription: Data width(in bits). A data width of 0 and a TotalWidth of 8 would indicate that the Memory is solely used to provide error correction bits.

Capacity.description: The total capacity of this memory, in bytes.
Capacity.longDescription: The total capacity of this memory, in bytes.

FruPartNumber.description: The FRU part number for this memory
FruPartNumber.longDescription: The value of this property shall be a fru part number assigned by the organization that is responsible for producing or manufacturing the memory.

HealthStatusString.description: The string describes health status for this memory
HealthStatusString.longDescription: The value of this property shall be a string for the health status for the memory.

SecurityStateString.description: The string describes security state for this memory
SecurityStateString.longDescription: The value of this property shall be a string for the security state for the memory.

LenovoMemory.description: This is the schema definition for the memory resource.  It represents the properties of a memory attached to a System.
